description: This file is a shell script used for performance testing of 'git merge-base'. It defines functions to build complex commit histories using git fast-import and performs tests to verify the behavior of 'git merge-base'.

methods.name: build_history
methods.description: Constructs a commit history with multiple merges to simulate complex traversal costs.

methods.name: build_history2
methods.description: Constructs a different merge history reusing root commits, resulting in multiple merge bases.
